scenarios.purpose: Run two deterministic retained inputs for each exact admitted model tuple and require model-specific semantic receipts.
assertions: Both distinct inputs pass the authoritative adapter validator.
Image, source, artifact, input, output and validator receipt digests are immutable and joined to one attempt.

scenarios.purpose: Overlap every requested primary and secondary lane with a bulk burst and customer-facing work.
assertions: Every admitted model has queued or active work in the same bounded observation window.
Unrelated tenant workloads and capacity remain untouched.

scenarios.purpose: Prove presentation and interactive requests overtake queued batch work without evicting protected presentation work.
assertions: Admission order follows the configured priority values when requests contend for the same flavor.
Preemption follows the policy snapshot and never relies on submission timestamps alone.

scenarios.purpose: Prove two tenants make bounded progress under sustained same-class bulk demand.
assertions: Both tenants receive admissions while both remain backlogged.
Observed share and dominant-resource debt match the frozen Kueue policy snapshot.

scenarios.purpose: Let idle quota be borrowed by bulk work, then prove timely reclaim for customer traffic.
assertions: Borrowed quota is visible in Kueue status before reclaim.
Reclaim selects only policy-eligible victims and the higher service class admits within its maximum queue bound.

scenarios.purpose: Observe an authorized task-owned preemptible loss and prove fenced retry; checkpoint resume is allowed only for an adapter with a reviewed resumable format.
assertions: The replacement attempt has a new attempt ID and cannot commit the predecessor output.
A restartable stage restarts from its last committed stage input; resume is asserted only when the exact adapter has a qualified checkpoint contract.
No failure injection occurs without a reviewed task-owned mechanism.

scenarios.purpose: In a serialized maintenance window or isolated preview, restart the provenance-matched integrated control plane and prove durable request continuity and idempotent replay.
assertions: Accepted operations survive process replacement without duplicate Jobs or artifacts.
API, MCP and admin projections converge on the same durable operation state.

level_policies.applicability_rule: Use only the H100 preemptible pool after sibling work is quiescent; preserve fixed capacity-block nodes and unrelated tenants.
Require the same exact node/GPU class with the runtime Pod absent and retain a node-preparation receipt.
Require immutable imageID equality and prove image layers local while the model artifacts remain nonlocal.
Require exact content manifest equality and prove the runtime process and GPU state are absent.
Applicable only when the reviewed model profile names a resumable checkpoint format and validation receipt.
The H100 nodes advertise snapshot eligibility false; never relabel cache/checkpoint reuse as a GPU snapshot.
Require the same Ready Pod UID/runtime process and a second distinct semantic input.

equations: end_to_end_ns = queue + scheduling + image_loading + artifact_loading + restoring + compilation + semantic_warmup + active_compute + workflow_wait + allocated_idle + resident_idle + grace_drain + teardown
allocated_gpu_ns = active_compute_gpu + allocated_idle_gpu + resident_idle_gpu + grace_drain_gpu + reconciliation_delta_gpu
allocated_idle_gpu = image_loading_gpu + artifact_loading_gpu + restoring_gpu + compilation_gpu + semantic_warmup_gpu + workflow_wait_gpu + scheduler_hold_gpu + unattributed_gpu
reconciliation_delta_gpu must equal zero in integer nanoseconds before display rounding; DCGM samples corroborate activity and device identity but never define allocation boundaries
every retry and preemption is a distinct attempt; operation totals equal the sum of attempt totals without overlapping a GPU UUID interval twice

surfaces.assertion: Every published endpoint has valid TLS and no insecure acceptance mode.

evidence: HTTP status and bounded body digest

surfaces.assertion: Scientific API validates, idempotently submits and returns the durable operation identity.

MCP invocation shares API idempotency, authorization and durable operation state.
Admin run list/detail display priority, access, attempts, lifecycle, artifacts and errors without payloads or secrets.

API, MCP and admin return the same operation/model/artifact identities and terminal state.

rollback.assertion: Record every shared deployment image tag, imageID digest, ReplicaSet revision and source commit before change.
The deploy commit contains currently deployed sibling work and all pre-existing public/admin/API/MCP features.
Record the exact prior immutable image digest and configuration digest for each changed component.
The previous control plane can read post-deploy durable state or a forward-only rollback exception is declared before deployment.
Kueue objects can be restored by exact UID-independent manifests without deleting unrelated workloads.
Model runtime and route identities return to their prior digests without touching retained caches.
Pre-existing user-visible models and task-owned scientific surfaces pass after rollback.
After deployment or rollback, the reviewed root produces a saved zero-change plan in the exact workspace.
